entry.title: India Still Needs to Address Harmful Dark Skin Stereotypes
entry.summary:

entry.title: Pension Peril Among Populations
entry.summary:
PORTLAND, USA, September 28 (IPS) - Dozens of government-funded pension programs providing benefits to hundreds of millions of men and women face growing fiscal strain and long-term sustainability challenges. These pressures are largely driven by rapid demographic transitions, including ageing populations, declining fertility, rising life expectancy, and shrinking workforces.
